_comment: Puzzle2048 wrapper profile (scripts/wrap_screenshots.py). Style: MODERATE — a clean, addictive number puzzle wants energy with breathing room, not a sticker storm. Keeps the existing warm cream/sand gradient (already on-theme). ADDS a handful of the game's iconic numbered tiles (2,4,8...2048) in their real tile colors: two big soft-blurred ones for depth + a few crisp ones with drop shadows in the corners/edges, one '2' tile peeking over the phone, plus two faint warm washes. Center board, headline, subtitle kept clear; positions jitter per slot.
